design: Very long-legged agile courier with a ridged elongated forehead, outward-curving upper mandibles and a single thick bundle of long dreadlocks draped forward over one shoulder. Asymmetric small travel half-cape leaving arms clear, a crescent-shaped ceramic dispatch case worn across the back and narrow crossed hip belts.
